heading_en: Notification Before the Application Date Concerning Trading Desks Using the Standardized Approach
summary_ja: 前条を、標準的方式を用いるトレーディング・デスクに係る届出書に準用する。
summary_en: The preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis to notifications for trading desks using the standardized approach.
paragraphs: The preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that submits a notification concerning trading desks using the standardized approach (meaning the standardized approach prescribed in Article 1, item (xii-4) of the New Public Notice). In this case, the words "Article 11-14" in the preceding Article shall be read as "Article 249-8", the words "the boundary between the banking book and the trading book" as "trading desks using the standardized approach (meaning the standardized approach prescribed in Article 1, item (xii-4) of the New Public Notice)", and the words "that Article" as "Article 249-8 of the New Public Notice".
